versions.subject: feat: new rules from blackberry
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
        - '/iptables'
        - '/xtables-legacy-multi'
        - '/iptables-legacy-multi'
        - '/ip6tables'
        - '/ip6tables-legacy-multi'
selection_params:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '-F'
        - '-Z'
        - '-X'
selection_ufw:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'ufw-logging-deny'
        - 'ufw-logging-allow'
        - 'ufw6-logging-deny'
        - 'ufw6-logging-allow'
        #- 'ufw-reject-output'
        #- 'ufw-track-inputt'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*/iptables", "*/xtables-legacy-multi", "*/iptables-legacy-multi", "*/ip6tables", "*/ip6tables-legacy-multi") CommandLine IN ("*-F*", "*-Z*", "*-X*") CommandLine IN ("*ufw-logging-deny*", "*ufw-logging-allow*", "*ufw6-logging-deny*", "*ufw6-logging-allow*")
